name: Omazel
author: Brian Scott
description: Hazel-style file automation for Omarchy: watch folders, match rules, and move, rename, trash, extract, encrypt, or upload files automatically.

barWidget.description: Automated folder organization driven by rules in ~/.config/omazel/rules.toml, with pause, dry-run, and an activity feed in the bar.

schema.label: Rules file
schema.description: TOML file defining watched folders, rules, and actions.

schema.label: Sweep interval (seconds, 0 to disable)
schema.description: How often to re-scan watched folders. The sweep is what fires age-based rules and catches files that arrived while the shell was off; inotify handles new arrivals instantly either way.

schema.label: Settle delay (seconds)
schema.description: How long a file must sit quietly after arriving before rules judge it, so downloads and copies are not caught half-written.

schema.label: Per-file rule cooldown (seconds)
schema.description: Minimum time before the same rule may act on the same file again, keeping the watcher and the sweep from double-firing and failed actions from retrying in a tight loop.

schema.label: Start paused
schema.description: Come up with the engine paused after every shell restart, so rules only run once you resume them.

schema.label: Show session action count in the bar
Check for plugin updates every (seconds, 0 to disable)
schema.description: How often to fetch from the plugin's git remote to see whether a newer version is available. The popup shows an update row only when there is one. Set to 0 to never check.
